answer: Epochal proof-of-burn deters Sybil attacks in an agent economy trading ocean routing, marble grading, and archival quill records. To activate an identity for an epoch, a node sends base-layer tokens to a provably unspendable address hashing its public key and epoch index, then submits an inclusion proof. Each fake account thus incurs an irreversible, verifiable destruction of scarce economic value. Yet well-funded adversaries can still absorb the burn cost to operate large Sybil fleets.
